A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EMO-R3 work. All 11 pages, including text, equations, figures, tables and references, are readable and comparable. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original emotion-recognition experiments on EmoSet, Emotion6 and WebEmo, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, a case study and training-efficiency measurements in Section 4.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experimental results in Section 4, Tables 1–3 and Figures 3–5.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 are identical, including Structured Emotional Thinking, Reflective Emotional Reward, GRPO optimization and the optional Cold-Start-Emo procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use EmoSet, Emotion6 and WebEmo for the same visual emotion-recognition tasks, with identical in-domain and out-of-domain coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across Tables 1–3, including Vanilla, SEPM, SFT, GRPO and DAPO in their respective comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and the experimental tables retain the same sampling description, model configurations, four- and eight-rollout settings, training hyperparameters and accuracy-based evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: The Cold-Start-Emo experiment, SET/RER ablation, training-curve analysis, qualitative case study and efficiency analysis are identical in Tables 2–3 and Figures 3–5.

E5.justification: Both versions state that experiments were run three times and the median result was reported. Neither adds seed information, confidence intervals or significance testing.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports EMO-R3 overall accuracy of 60.50 and 60.42 for four and eight rollouts, respectively, in both versions.

T1.justification: The GRPO objective, advantage normalization and reward definitions, including Equations (1)–(6), are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain identical claims about structured emotional reasoning, reflective rewards, interpretability, generalization and benchmark performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of emotional subjectivity, Cold-Start-Emo alignment, DAPO training failure and computational overhead remain identical. No applicability boundaries or limitations are added.

D1.justification: The first-page repository pointer changes from xiaomi-research/emo-r3 to SeerRay-Lab/emo-r3 on GitHub. Other implementation and reproducibility information is unchanged; the PDFs do not establish whether resource availability improved.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning and all 70 references are identical. The repository-address update does not change the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: Only the first-page repository text and arXiv version/date stamp change. The prose, terminology, headings and section ordering are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: The shorter centered repository line and shifted arXiv margin stamp produce limited first-page layout differences. Figures 1–5, Tables 1–3 and the rendering of pages 2–11 are identical.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the same scientific content, experimental evidence and explanations. The repository-pointer update and minor first-page presentation changes do not establish a meaningful quality gain or loss; the supplied PDFs provide no evidence that code access or reproducibility improved.
